open ElementaryCommonPMixedMoment

def betaLogExponent (B : ℕ) : ℕ := (2 ^ B) ^ 2 - 1

def m2PolylogConstant (B : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  12 * mixedMomentConstant * (2 : ℝ) ^ betaLogExponent B

theorem m2PolylogConstant_pos (B : ℕ) : 0 < m2PolylogConstant B := by
  unfold m2PolylogConstant
  exact mul_pos
    (mul_pos (by norm_num) mixedMomentConstant_pos_and_mixedSum_le.1)
    (pow_pos (by norm_num) _)

/-- A scale comparison, valid also at x=V=1 and at exponent zero later. -/
theorem log_two_mul_bounds {x V : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (hV : 1 ≤ V)
    (hVx : V ≤ x) :
    0 ≤ 1 + Real.log (2 * V) ∧
      1 + Real.log (2 * V) ≤ 2 * (1 + Real.log x) := by
  have hVpos : 0 < V := zero_lt_one.trans_le hV
  have hlogx : 0 ≤ Real.log x := Real.log_nonneg hx
  have hlog2 : Real.log (2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
    have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)
    linarith
  constructor
  · have h := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith : 1 ≤ 2 * V)
    linarith
  · have hlogV : Real.log V ≤ Real.log x := Real.log_le_log hVpos hVx
    rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0) hVpos.ne']
    linarith

end
end ImbalancedChen.Part3.CommonPM2PolylogMajorant

/-- Cancel the sole Q1 ratio against the actual outside second moments. -/
theorem MediumAtom.cleaned_commonP_M2_le_capped_mixedMoment_with_beta_log
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) (hsigma : 0 < sigma)
    (hkappa : 0 ≤ kappa) (hcap : kappa ≤ 1 / (2 * (kshift : ℝ))) :
    CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d * CommonPM2FiniteFold.moment d ≤
      12 * mixedMomentConstant * d.scale ^ 2 *
        (1 + Real.log (2 * d.V)) ^ betaLogExponent B *
          (1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ 131073 := by
  have hx : 1 ≤ d.scale := by
    change (1 : ℝ) ≤ d.U * d.V
    simpa only [one_mul] using
      mul_le_mul hd.1 hd.2.1 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) (zero_le_one.trans hd.1)
  have hx0 : 0 ≤ d.scale := zero_le_one.trans hx
  have hQpos : 0 < d.Q1 := zero_lt_one.trans_le hd.2.2.1
  have hfactor : 0 ≤ 3 * d.U / d.Q1 :=
    div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (zero_le_one.trans hd.1)) hQpos.le
  have hL : 0 ≤ 1 + Real.log d.scale := by
    linarith [Real.log_nonneg hx]
  have hmain : 0 ≤ mixedMomentConstant * d.scale *
      (1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ 131073 :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg mixedMomentConstant_pos_and_mixedSum_le.1.le hx0)
      (pow_nonneg hL _)
  have hlength : (4 * d.V * d.Q1) * (3 * d.U / d.Q1) = 12 * d.scale := by
    calc
      (4 * d.V * d.Q1) * (3 * d.U / d.Q1) =
          (4 * d.V) * ((3 * d.U / d.Q1) * d.Q1) := by ac_rfl
      _ = (4 * d.V) * (3 * d.U) := by rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hQpos.ne']
      _ = 12 * d.scale := by unfold MediumAtom.scale; ring
  calc
    CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d * CommonPM2FiniteFold.moment d ≤
        CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d *
          ((3 * d.U / d.Q1) *
            (mixedMomentConstant * d.scale * (1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ 131073)) :=
      d.cleaned_commonP_M2_le_capped_mixedMoment hd hsigma hkappa hcap
    _ ≤ (4 * d.V * d.Q1 * (1 + Real.log (2 * d.V)) ^ betaLogExponent B) *
        ((3 * d.U / d.Q1) *
          (mixedMomentConstant * d.scale * (1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ 131073)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (d.sharedFirstFactor_outside_le hd)
        (mul_nonneg hfactor hmain)
    _ = ((4 * d.V * d.Q1) * (3 * d.U / d.Q1)) *
        (mixedMomentConstant * d.scale) *
          ((1 + Real.log (2 * d.V)) ^ betaLogExponent B *
            (1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ 131073) := by ac_rfl
    _ = (12 * d.scale) * (mixedMomentConstant * d.scale) *
        ((1 + Real.log (2 * d.V)) ^ betaLogExponent B *
          (1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ 131073) := by rw [hlength]
    _ = _ := by rw [pow_two d.scale]; ac_rfl

/-- Merge the two logarithms with a constant depending only on B. -/
theorem MediumAtom.cleaned_commonP_M2_le_capped_polylog
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) (hsigma : 0 < sigma)
    (hkappa : 0 ≤ kappa) (hcap : kappa ≤ 1 / (2 * (kshift : ℝ))) :
    CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d * CommonPM2FiniteFold.moment d ≤
      m2PolylogConstant B * d.scale ^ 2 *
        (1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ (131073 + betaLogExponent B) := by
  have hx : 1 ≤ d.scale := by
    change (1 : ℝ) ≤ d.U * d.V
    simpa only [one_mul] using
      mul_le_mul hd.1 hd.2.1 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) (zero_le_one.trans hd.1)
  have hVx : d.V ≤ d.scale := by
    change d.V ≤ d.U * d.V
    simpa only [one_mul] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hd.1 (zero_le_one.trans hd.2.1)
  have hlogs := log_two_mul_bounds hx hd.2.1 hVx
  have hp : (1 + Real.log (2 * d.V)) ^ betaLogExponent B ≤
      (2 * (1 + Real.log d.scale)) ^ betaLogExponent B :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ hlogs.1 hlogs.2 _
  have hL : 0 ≤ 1 + Real.log d.scale := by
    linarith [Real.log_nonneg hx]
  have hcoefficient : 0 ≤ 12 * mixedMomentConstant * d.scale ^ 2 :=
    mul_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) mixedMomentConstant_pos_and_mixedSum_le.1.le)
      (sq_nonneg _)
  calc
    CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d * CommonPM2FiniteFold.moment d ≤
        12 * mixedMomentConstant * d.scale ^ 2 *
          (1 + Real.log (2 * d.V)) ^ betaLogExponent B *
            (1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ 131073 :=
      d.cleaned_commonP_M2_le_capped_mixedMoment_with_beta_log hd hsigma hkappa hcap
    _ ≤ 12 * mixedMomentConstant * d.scale ^ 2 *
        (2 * (1 + Real.log d.scale)) ^ betaLogExponent B *
          (1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ 131073 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp hcoefficient)
        (pow_nonneg hL _)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [mul_pow (2 : ℝ) (1 + Real.log d.scale) (betaLogExponent B),
        pow_add (1 + Real.log d.scale) 131073 (betaLogExponent B)]
      unfold m2PolylogConstant
      ac_rfl

/-- Fix C_B>0 before sigma, kappa, c0, the scale and the moving residue. -/
theorem CommonPM2PolylogMajorant.constant_pos_and_uniform (B : ℕ) :
    0 < m2PolylogConstant B ∧
      ∀ (sigma kappa c0 : ℝ) (d : MediumAtom),
        MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d → 0 < sigma → 0 ≤ kappa →
          kappa ≤ 1 / (2 * (kshift : ℝ)) →
        CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d * CommonPM2FiniteFold.moment d ≤
          m2PolylogConstant B * d.scale ^ 2 *
            (1 + Real.log d.scale) ^ (131073 + betaLogExponent B) := by
  refine ⟨m2PolylogConstant_pos B, ?_⟩
  intro sigma kappa c0 d hd hsigma hkappa hcap
  exact d.cleaned_commonP_M2_le_capped_polylog hd hsigma hkappa hcap

end

def MediumAdmissible (B : ℕ) (σ κ c0 : ℝ) (d : MediumAtom) : Prop :=

  c0 * d.scale ≤ (d.residue.natAbs : ℝ) ∧
  (d.residue.natAbs : ℝ) ≤ d.scale ^ (1 + κ) ∧
  d.Q1 < d.U * d.scale ^ (-σ) ∧
  d.U ^ 2 * d.Q2 * d.Q3 ^ 2 < d.scale ^ (1 - 8 * σ) ∧
  (d.residue.natAbs : ℝ) ^ (7 / 32 : ℝ) * d.U * d.Q1 * d.Q2 ^ 5 * d.Q3 ^ 2 <
    d.scale ^ (2 - 15 * σ) ∧
  d.U ^ (1 + 2 * (7 / 32 : ℝ)) * d.Q1 *
      d.Q2 ^ (5 - 2 * (7 / 32 : ℝ)) * d.Q3 ^ (2 + 2 * (7 / 32 : ℝ)) <
    d.scale ^ (2 - 15 * σ) ∧

    Nat.Prime p → p ∣ n →

  (∀ m ∈ d.betaCarrier, ‖d.beta m‖ ≤ (m.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ B) ∧

    (d.gamma1 q ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime q d.residue.natAbs)) ∧
